from collections import Counter
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find the solid 2x2 block color
    cand=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg]
    # anchor: 2x2 solid square of non-bg color(s); pick color forming exactly 4 cells in a 2x2
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    anchor=None; acolor=None
    for c in cand:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        if len(cs)==4 and max(i for i,_ in cs)-min(i for i,_ in cs)+1==2 and max(j for _,j in cs)-min(j for _,j in cs)+1==2:
            anchor=cs; acolor=c; break
    arows=[i for i,_ in anchor]; acols=[j for _,j in anchor]
    r0,r1=min(arows),max(arows); c0,c1=min(acols),max(acols)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==bg: continue
            if (i,j) in anchor: out[i][j]=v; continue
            if v!=acolor: continue
            ii=i; jj=j
            # reflect if outside anchor span
            mir_i = r0+r1-i if (i<r0 or i>r1) else i
            mir_j = c0+c1-j if (j<c0 or j>c1) else j

            # also mirror each individually into both quadrants? just place mirrored copies

import json
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    anchor=None; acolor=None
    for i in range(h-1):
        for j in range(w-1):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=bg and g[i+1][j]==v and g[i][j+1]==v and g[i+1][j+1]==v:
                anchor=(i,j,v); break
    if anchor is None: return [r[:] for r in g]
    ai,aj,c=anchor
    pat=[(r,cc) for r in range(h) for cc in range(w) if g[r][cc]!=bg and not(ai<=r<=ai+1 and aj<=cc<=aj+1)]
    res=set(pat)
    for r,cc in pat:
        res.add((2*ai+1-r,cc)); res.add((r,2*aj+1-cc)); res.add((2*ai+1-r,2*aj+1-cc))
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for a in (ai,ai+1):
        for b in (aj,aj+1):
            out[a][b]=c
    for r,cc in res: out[r][cc]=c
    return out
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']

    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for a in (ai,ai+1):
